questions.prompt: The Chernobyl disaster occurred in which year?
questions.fact: The accident happened during a safety test intended to check what would occur in a power failure.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the middle number in an ordered data set?
questions.fact: It resists outliers, which is why income is usually reported this way rather than as an average.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a stroke called the drive?
questions.fact: The word means much the same in each: a firm forward stroke intended to send the ball a long way.

questions.prompt: Which film features the line about a boat needing to be bigger?
questions.fact: The line was reportedly improvised, and became an in-joke referring to the production's constant problems.

questions.prompt: Which mountain range separates Europe from Asia in the south?
questions.fact: Its highest peak, Elbrus, is generally counted as the highest mountain in Europe.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Small Island?
questions.fact: It follows Jamaican migrants arriving in post-war Britain, drawing on her own father's crossing.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Node.js runtime?
questions.fact: It put JavaScript on the server by embedding the engine Google had built for Chrome.
